title: Book One · Chapter 183: Past the Old Door
story:
The next Sunday, after breakfast, Dad is ready.

Ronan is ready before him.

“I can see that,” Mum says.

Ronan put his shoes on a long time ago. Now he is waiting by the door.

They start in a quiet place. Ronan rides slowly. Dad walks beside him. Mum watches from the side.

At first, Ronan’s arms are too stiff.

He keeps looking down at the front wheel.

“Look ahead. Which way do you want to go? Look that way,” Dad tells him.

Ronan looks up.

The bike moves more easily.

He stops, starts, and stops again. He practises until his hands feel less tight.

Mum goes home to finish her own work. Ronan and Dad walk toward River Street.

At busy corners, Ronan gets off and walks the bike. Dad points to a place beside the road. “Wait here,” he tells Ronan. They take their time.

Ronan can see over the low wall from the seat. He can see some new things too. He did not see them on his walks.

A flower grows from a crack near a drain. A small sign hangs under a shop window. A man lifts the same sack twice before he finds a good way to carry it.

Ronan gets off near Mr Qiu’s place.

Mr Qiu comes to look.

“Blue.”

“Yes.”

“And the old bell.”

Ronan gives it one small ring.

Mr Qiu nods.

“I know that sound.”

They talk for a little while. Then Ronan and Dad go on.

The old shop is not far away.

Ronan slows before Dad says anything.

The door is open. Inside, there are things on shelves. They are not Dad’s tools. Someone is moving a box near the back. Ronan does not know that person.

The wall has new paint.

“It is different,” Ronan says.

“Yes.”

“Do you want to go in?”

Dad thinks for a moment.

“Not today.”

Ronan nods. He does not push the bike toward the door.

They stand outside. A woman passes with a bag of vegetables. She looks at Dad and says hello. He asks about her family.

Ronan waits. The bike rests against his leg.

Dad has a small smile when the woman leaves.

“Ready?”

Ronan looks at the doorway once more.

Ronan remembers a man in a blue shirt. That day, Ronan held the red bike with one hand. The man held the bike too. Ronan remembers that moment.

He looks down at his own hand now.

It is on a blue handlebar. His fingers are longer than they were that day. He has grown since then. But he still remembers his tears beside the red bike.

“I’m ready.”

They go along the street together.

Near the corner, Leo calls his name. Ronan stops and gets off.

Leo walks round the bike.

“Can I try it one day?”

Ronan puts a hand on the seat.

At first, he does not want anyone else to ride his new bike. Then he listens to the rest of Leo's question.

Then he looks at his friend.

“When we have a good place. And someone can watch.”

“All right.”

Leo touches the scratch near the back wheel.

“Fast?”

“I don’t know yet.”

“It looks fast.”

“It looks blue.”

Leo laughs. Dad laughs too.

On the way home, Ronan gets off at the narrow part and walks beside the bike. Dad showed him this narrow part earlier. Now he remembers the safe way through. At the green gate, he rings the bell once.

Mum opens it.

“How far did you go?”

Ronan looks at Dad.

“Past the old door,” he says.

Then he takes the bike inside.
studyGuide:
## 重点表达
- stiff：僵硬的。
- crack：裂缝。
- drain：排水口。
- doorway：门口。

## 理解
1. 经过旧店时，Ronan怎样回应父亲的选择？
2. Ronan对借车的回应表现了怎样的变化？
